notes.title: Update #1.3.0 from 04/08/2021.
notes.notes:
Innovations.

- Added the classic skill tree. Now players can not only pump with a shoulder gun or implants, but also develop those skills of your character they need.


Gameplay.

- The missions are divided into two types: story missions and side tasks. Side tasks are now no longer required to complete. The player can go through the main story and only then begin to complete side quests or pass them in parallel with the main missions;
- Redesigned game economy: reduced the cost of weapons and consumables, such as first aid kits, grenades, etc., as well as increased revenue from completing missions;
- Increased reload and power of weapons;
- Added the ability to change the difficulty level during the game. The player can change it in the settings at any time, the changes will take effect from the start of the next mission. Game achievements will be counted according to the minimum level of difficulty used.


Difficulty levels.

- Now the difficulty levels differ only in the monsters’ damage, the probability of drop of unique equipment and the amount of money received.


General.

- Improved game stability, reduced the chance of crashes.


Bugs.

- Fixed an issue with the game crashing in the inventory;
- Fixed a bug with opening the backpack by clicking on the log button.


Attention!

Due to the fact that the missions were divided into story and side tasks, during the run of the save, players’ progress was reset, but the character level was remain the same, and all the items players got during the game, such as weapons, first aid kits, grenades, etc. are in backpack and are available for use at any level.

notes.title: Converter
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Do you consider yourself lucky enough to take a chance?

We present to your attention the Converter. This terrible at first glance machine is used to recycle unnecessary (or even necessary) equipment into a random item. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35414638/85d7c0174990d207b21b753246fe8b4aecc1fda9.jpg[/img]

You can try your luck and convert low-quality stuff into excellent equipment. Or maybe vice-versa. Push your luck ;) 

Principles of operation of the Converter:

- from three items of equipment creates one random; 

- the chance to obtain subject with high characteristics more, than under the usual drop;

- the chance to get a high quality item depends on the total quality of the converted items; 

- the type of the created object in an equal ratio depends on the types of the transformation object. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35414638/edd8f7ccc0961bff4740b091afa1413023bcc7d0.png[/img]

After returning from the mission, load the found guns into the Converter and enjoy the result. And don't be afraid of his terrifying look — the Converter is completely safe. Probably.

p. s. And Yes, if you think you have already seen the second screenshot in the previous post, you are right. Mistakes happen ;)

notes.title: Fusion gun
notes.notes:
What first comes to mind when you hear "fusion gun"? Correctly. 

Still. More. Blood.

Another novelty straight from Alien Shooter 2: Legend for PC. Fusion shoulder mount, operating in two modes: attack and defense and using simultaneously with hand weapons.

In attack mode the gun can be activated by clicking the right mouse button. Clamp it at the moment, while firing at the enemy from the usual hand weapons, and enjoy the spectacle of the enemy roaring in pain. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35414638/9d5c8693369b6fd57400d5bc8a0f14db65a97e65.png[/img]

In the protection mode the installation creates a protective field around the character and, by clicking the right mouse button, scatters enemies who dare to approach with a shock wave. 

Fusion gun can be upgraded. Pumping protection mode, you will increase the range of the installation, to build in the ability to slow down enemies. Developing the attack mode, you will give the installation the ability to cause more damage to enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35414638/199a70b3a1ae4e2180adffbfab2a78997876a30e.png[/img]

In order to improve the installation, during the game collect weapons and bring them to the laboratory for parts. 

Using a fusion shoulder mount, do not forget about caution: shots from it are very effective, but take a lot of energy.

notes.title: Redesigned shooting system in Alien Shooter 2: Legend
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We apologize for the long silence — we were so passionate about working on Alien Shooter 2: Legend on Steam that there was no time for news at all. Now that the preparation of the game came almost to the finish line, we decided to share with you  some novelties that will be waiting for you in the game. 

Today we will tell you about the completely redesigned shooting system in Alien Shooter 2: Legend. 

Here is one of the most important changes: in the new game, unlike previous versions, for the first time, a 3D method of calculating the trajectory of the bullet is used. Previously, the trajectory was calculated on the ground, which means that the bullet always hit the nearest monster to the player, regardless of it's size. Now, if you are attacked with a small and a big alien at once, you will be able to shoot at a more dangerous monster over the head of small fry.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35414638/d256eb4a3fc8e500c43996de96ece6b15b11cbe9.jpg[/img]

The physics of the bullet's flight has also been completely redesigned, shooting has become more realistic. 

Updated shotgun - when you shoot from a distance there is a scatter of shot: to destroy several enemies with one shot became real.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35414638/5b8871505bae56c8a25d156f823395fb56b153ab.jpg[/img]

The accuracy of the hit now depends, among other things, on the position of the character: as in life, you should stop to aim more accurately.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35414638/7be2151725bd7b82cf4fabea82aa45247fce036a.jpg[/img]

And finally the most interesting: for rocket launchers added the ability to fire guided missiles! You can control the trajectory and range of the projectile - now launch a missile at the enemy from around the corner has become much easier. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35414638/191aab4e965610b891a31501d4c82b9517564464.jpg[/img]

Which of the new chips are you most excited about?
